decision_scope: Approve or revise only the compositional writing architecture. Do not create syllabification, diphthongs, glide rules, visual canon, semantics, morphology, grammar or curriculum authority.

recommended_decisions.decision: Approve Mix-Glifo as a compositional writing layer above G01-G40, not a replacement for root G-IDs.
Approve ROOT profile immediately; all multi-root compression remains gated by explicit grouping/syllabification authority.
Approve the role-based geometry contract NUCLEUS/PRE/POST while keeping exact coordinates and current Candidate D visuals noncanonical.
Forbid rotation/mirroring and destructive deformation in V1.
Approve maximum four root G-IDs per compressed V1 cell.
Approve lossless deterministic MX1 keying and defer PUA/font allocation.
